verdict.rationale: Cal.com's docs state the platform powers round-robin scheduling, and its team event-type scheduling configuration exposes round-robin hosts with priority, weight and group assignment, plus a weights toggle, lead threshold and no-show calculations. A routing trace documents the host-selection logic behind each booking, so weighted and prioritized distribution is a documented first-party capability. Missing for 10: in-depth docs explaining how weighting and priority balance load in practice (the evidence is mostly API config schema), and independent or hands-on corroboration that distribution stays fair.
